summary: Analyze complete. Headline: GAP-02 is an adopt, not a build - jsonwebtoken 11 is already a direct dependency (Cargo.toml:393) and ships a complete jwk module (JwkSet, find-by-kid, DecodingKey::from_jwk), verified by reading crate source on disk. reqwest 0.12 with rustls-tls-native-roots already covers the HTTPS fetch; no new dependency and no feature change. Dedicated JWKS wrapper crates rejected: none present, all wrap the same primitives, and adding a dependency on the auth path to avoid ~150 lines of fetch-and-cache is a poor trade. Everything else is build (pure wiring or field/key-type changes). Execution order GAP-02 -> GAP-03a -> GAP-03b is load-bearing; GAP-05 is file-disjoint and may run in parallel. Four risks recorded, R-4 sharpest: Validation::default() checks neither iss nor aud, so 'signature verifies' must not be read as 'token is valid'.
warnings: R-1 OQ-2 gates GAP-03a only; GAP-02 and GAP-05 can proceed without it
R-2 the middleware.rs:85 bypass sits inside GAP-02's blast radius
R-3 every fail-closed assertion needs a paired negative control proving it can fail
R-4 Validation::default() enforces neither issuer nor audience
